mechanism_narrative: The FEDFUNDS rate is negatively correlated with S&P 500 returns, so the current rate of 0.19% predicts positive 20-day returns due to historically low rates compressing discount rates.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances with FEDFUNDS <= 0.2%, or Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A UNRATE above 5.0% predicts negative 20-day S&P 500 returns due to weak labor market conditions signaling economic slowdown and reduced corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances with UNRATE > 5.0, or Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL is above 215 and FEDFUNDS is below 0.2%, it predicts positive 20-day S&P 500 returns as this combination indicates low inflation and accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances with CPIAUCSL > 215 AND FEDFUNDS < 0.2, or Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 2.0% and CPIAUCSL > 220), S&P 500 forward returns are negative due to reduced liquidity and growth concerns.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances during monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 2.0 AND CPIAUCSL > 220), or Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The PAYEMS level is positively correlated with S&P 500 returns, so the current level of 130311.0 (thousands) predicts positive 5-day returns due to strong labor market conditions supporting consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances with PAYEMS > 130000, or Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL above 220 predicts negative 60-day S&P 500 returns due to inflationary pressures leading to monetary tightening and reduced equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances with CPIAUCSL > 220, or Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When INDPRO is above 90 and HOUST is below 550, it predicts negative 5-day S&P 500 returns due to weakening manufacturing (INDPRO) and housing (HOUST) sectors reducing economic growth expectations.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances with INDPRO > 90 AND HOUST < 550, or Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a demand-driven expansion (GDPC1 > 13000 and RSAFS > 350000), S&P 500 forward returns are positive due to strong economic growth and consumer spending supporting corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances during demand expansion (GDPC1 > 13000 AND RSAFS > 350000), or Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.
